findings_qualitative.value: CO, Halpha and UV mismatch on ~1 kpc scales is explained by different star-formation stages; CO clouds lie farther from the disk in the southern tail

evidence.quote: We interpret this as a star formation sequence, in which star formation progresses from the molecular cloud phase with no stars formed yet

claims.hypothesis: Does the CO/Halpha/UV mismatch reflect star formation stages?
claims.experiment: Compared CO(2-1), Halpha, NUV and BPT maps
claims.result: Regions with CO only, CO+Halpha+UV, Halpha+UV and UV only form a spatial sequence
claims.finding: Different stages of star formation explain the small-scale mismatch

evidence.quote: argue that the mismatch on small scales (1kpc) is due to different stages of the star formation process

claims.hypothesis: Is the X-ray tail powered by star formation or stripped halo?
claims.experiment: X-ray spectral fits, SFR calibration comparison, halo stripping model
claims.result: X-ray SFR is 4-30 times Halpha SFR; halo stripped in ~15 Myr
claims.finding: ISM heating by the ICM is the favoured origin

evidence.quote: We conclude that a significant fraction of the X-ray emission of JW100 must arise from heating of its stripped ISM

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Tidal interaction with the BCG disfavoured

evidence.quote: Finally, the one-sided ionized gas tail and its direction with respect to the BCG disfavour the tidal hypothesis.

limitations_admitted.value: X-ray data cannot distinguish models or confirm the bow shock
